runs.description: Pre-publish regression: claude/opus reviews gson via pip-local-wheel (Mode A) against the post-192 SKILL.md and freshly-staged _bundle. gson is the only repo without clean post-192 data — express (opus npm) and chi (codex Mode B) both MET on the post-191 harness run, and the 192 delta (1 kind-B paragraph restoration + 12 kind-A test updates + banner ASCII conversion) is small enough that re-running them adds runtime with near-zero signal value. Expected outcome: 1-2 bug yield on gson@main (single-pass opus ceiling per three prior runs). The secondary signal is reproducibility of the Phase 5 API timeout that BLOCKED the prior post-192 attempt — if it recurs, that's a real claude-code stream-json mode issue worth investigating before publish.
